sections.title: II. Read the following passage and choose the best answer A, B, C or D. (1.0 point)
sections.introHtml:
In a big pretty countryside, there's a vast and friendly place with lots of fields and fruit trees. Farmers there use a well-trained machine called a combine harvester to catch all the ripe crops.

Early in the day, the farmers with their cows and groups of animals get together to work on the land. They use big tools called ploughs to get the soil ready for a good harvest. Then, the animals are guided to the large fields where special rice plants, called paddy fields, grow.

Not too far away, there's a tall tower called a lighthouse that helps a boat called a ferry cross a river, carrying people and things between places.

The farmers keep busy all day, using the combine harvester to harvest the crops. They put everything on trucks to take it to markets. The machine also helps get milk from the cows, so there's fresh dairy.

As the sun goes down, the farmers work hard to get everything ready for storage. They make sure the crops are dry and safe. The landscape, with its pretty fields and trees, shows how much work they've put into making their community a nice and productive place.

3. Language: (0.3 point): a variety of vocabulary and structures appropriate to the level of secondary students.

4. Presentation: (0.2 point): Coherence, cohesion and style appropriate to the level of secondary students.
